subject: Life Skills
title: Lifestyle Creep Awareness
description: A quick, practical guide to Lifestyle Creep Awareness.

hook.text: He got a 40% raise. One year later, he was saving the same amount. New apartment, new car, new gym. Raise erased.

buildup.text: Lifestyle creep is the tendency to spend more as you earn more. Each upgrade feels justified in the moment.

discovery.text: The hedonic treadmill drives it. Higher spending becomes the new normal.

twist.text: People who earn $200k with lifestyle creep often have less savings than disciplined earners making $80k.

climax.text: When income rises, save the raise first. Increase savings by at least 50% of every raise before upgrading your.

punchline.text: Earn more, save more. Not earn more, spend more.

quiz.question: What drives lifestyle creep?
options: The hedonic treadmill makes higher spending feel normal, pushing you to need even more
Tax brackets that take more of your income
